sources.title: AI-generated Essays: Characteristics and Implications on Automated ...
sources.snippet: Using large-scale empirical data, we examine and benchmark the characteristics and quality of essays generated by popular LLMs and discuss their implications for two key components of writing assessments: automated scoring and academic integrity.
